Hints: Look at the sign of the leading coefficient.;A negative coefficient flips the parabola.
Solution: The squared term has coefficient -1. A positive leading coefficient opens a parabola upward; a negative one opens it downward. Thus this graph opens downward.

Question Choices: What is the axis of symmetry of y=(x-2)(x-10)?
Hints: The axis is midway between the roots.;Average 2 and 10.
Solution: The symmetry line lies halfway between the roots 2 and 10: h=(2+10)/2=6. The vertex lies on this vertical line. Axis: x=6.
